newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks closed down on profit taking.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks closed down on profit taking.

text.p: Dhaka stocks closed lower amid selling pressure as the small investors cashed in gains from rises over the past three straight sessions, brokers said.
The Dhaka Stock Exchange all-share price index fell 66.28 points or 5.23 percent at 1,198.78 on a turnover of 79.04 million taka. Of 122 traded issues 102 lost, 18 gained and two unchanged.

"There were more sellers than buyers in the market. The market fell because of profit-taking by small investors," said one broker. Aziz Pipes fell 878 taka to 1,180, Chic Tex rose 1.43 to 15.7 and Chittagong Cement was down 193 to 1,999.
